patch.value: Add pm brief duplicates post-merge near-duplicate sweep

Register a 'brief duplicates' subcommand that sweeps the merged tracker for near-duplicate items the create-time advisory cannot see across agent branches, using the shared SDK findSimilarItems primitive. Collapses A~B/B~A into unordered pairs, ranks by score, and emits advisory remediation commands.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Orchestrator performance testing on a real 1,934-item tracker (copy of pm-cli's own .agents/pm, never mutated): unscoped full sweep = 39.1s / 526 MB peak RSS; --since scoped to 42 candidates = 2.7s / 271 MB. Confirmed the cost is inherent to the per-candidate SDK query (source=metadata_fallback re-reads tracker metadata on each of N calls). Measured the obvious alternative too: reading once and scoring 1,869,211 pairs in memory with the exported scoreItemSimilarity takes 29.1s because it re-tokenizes both titles per call. A tokenize-once + jaccard pre-filter is NOT sound: issue_code pairs score 0.99 with low token overlap (verified on two real pairs in that tracker) so a pre-filter silently drops the duplicates that matter most, and the issue-code extractor is not exported. Documented the cost table in README and filed upstream pm-cli#709 requesting a batch entry point / pre-tokenized scoring variant / exported issue-code extractor.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Addressed CodeRabbit review round 2 (7 of 8 findings actioned). (1) selectDuplicateCandidates now THROWS on an unparseable since instead of silently keeping every item — Date.parse yields NaN and created < NaN is always false, so the exported SDK path could silently widen a sweep. (2) buildDuplicateSweep rejects a non-positive or non-integer limit instead of reporting a clean tracker alongside a non-zero scanned count; the CLI also validates via readNonNegativeInt. (3) Added total and truncated to the summary so a caller can distinguish 3 pairs found from 3 of 40 shown, matching brief since and brief diverge. (4) Pair ids now travel in the map value rather than being re-parsed out of the composite key. (5) buildDuplicateSweep accepts a caller-supplied candidate list so the status/since filter runs once instead of twice. (6) Scans now run with bounded concurrency (8 in flight) — MEASURED, not assumed: 39.1s/526MB sequential vs 36.3s/268MB concurrent on the real 1,934-item tracker. Only ~7% wall clock because findSimilarItems is CPU-bound and concurrency cannot parallelize CPU work on a single-threaded event loop; the real win is peak memory roughly halved. Comments and README corrected to state this honestly rather than claiming a large speed-up. (7) README example fence languaged as console for MD040. Declined finding 1 (keep the item open until merge) with evidence: this repo closes items in the PR — pm-web-acwm closed 2h before its PR merged — and --respect-item-release files an open-PR closure under Unreleased, not under a released heading. Gates: typecheck clean, 121/121 tests pass (was 115, +6 covering limit edges, unparseable since, missing created_at, unresolvable pair, and candidate passthrough).
